instances.label: Appfire production
instances.credential_hint: Set XRAY_CLIENT_ID, XRAY_CLIENT_SECRET, JIRA_EMAIL, and JIRA_API_TOKEN for your production Appfire account before Execute.

instances.label: Appfire sandbox (774)
instances.credential_hint: Use sandbox-specific Xray API keys (Global Settings → API Keys). Export the same four env vars before Execute; they apply to whichever instance you selected in Studio.
